content.text: Meghalaya Arunachal Pradesh travel packages are quite popular since they allow you to see some of the most stunningly gorgeous places in northeast India. With a world heritage recognised national park, stunning waterfalls, rising mountains, and lush valleys, this wonderful destination offers something for everyone, whether it is nature lovers, animal enthusiasts, adrenaline junkies, or tranquillity seekers. In this 8 Days tour, you will be visiting the best locations of both Meghalaya and Arunachal Pradesh.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Sightseeing of the beautiful Umiam Lake
Visit Don Bosco Museum which showcases the local culture of the tribals
Cherrapunji's spectacular waterfalls and fascinating tunnels are worth visiting
Visit Kaziranga to see a variety of wildlife species
Travel to Dirang to visit the National Research Centre of Yak
Visit Arunachal Pradesh's Dirang Dzong, an exquisite ancient structure
Witness the beautiful Sela Pass and Sela Lake of Tawang
Tawang Monastery, Pankang Teng Tso Lake, Shonga-tser Lake and Tawang War Memorial are among the sights to see
The beautiful Nuranang waterfalls, Bomdila Monastery, and Tipi Orchidarium are all worth seeing

main.title: 8 Days Tour of Meghalaya and Arunachal Pradesh Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Pickup from Guwahati
items: Our local representative will pick you up from the airport and drive you to Shillong.
En route witness the beautiful scenic view of Umiam Lake.
Also, visit the famous Nehru Park of Barapani.
After reaching Shillong visit the Don Bosco Museum which showcases the local culture of tribals
Check-in at your hotel in Shillong for a restful sleep.

days.title: Day 2 : Shillong to Cherrapunji
items: After your breakfast head to Cherrapunji.
Visit the wettest place on Earth and admire its beauty.
Sightseeing of the stunning Nohkalikai Falls, Wei Sawdong Falls and Seven Sister Falls.
Visit Eco Park and spend some quality time with your loved ones.
In the evening return to Shillong and Check-in at your hotel.

days.title: Day 3 : Shillong - Kaziranga
items: After a hearty breakfast, depart for Kaziranga.
After reaching Kaziranga check in to your hotel and take rest.
Later stroll in the evening around Kaziranga.

days.title: Day 4 : Kaziranga Safari and Dirang
items: Have your delightful breakfast and start your day for safari.
Enjoy Elephant Safari and Jeep Safari at the Kaziranga National Park and witness different animals including one-horned rhinoceros and tiger.
Later head to Dirang and check in to your hotel.

days.title: Day 5 : Dirang to Tawang
items: After breakfast spend the day exploring Dirang's wonderful sights.
Visit the National Research Centre of Yak, Hot water spring, Sangti Valley and Kalachakra Gompa
Visit Arunachal Pradesh's Dirang Dzong, an exquisite ancient structure
Later head to Tawang and along the way, take in the sights of Sela Pass and the beautiful Sela Lake.
Check-in at your hotel in Tawang.

days.title: Day 6 : Sightseeing in Tawang
items: After a delicious breakfast, visit the breathtaking Nuranang Falls.
Visit the Tawang artisan district, where you can buy beautiful masks, handmade carpets, and silver, coral, and amber jewellery.
Visit the amazing Tawang Monastery, Pankang Teng Tso Lake, Shonga-tser Lake and Tawang War Memorial.
Check in to your hotel.

days.title: Day 7 : Tawang - Tezpur Stay
items: Travel to Tezpur after an early breakfast.
En-route visit the amazing Bomdila Monastery and Tipi Orchidarium.
Evening at leisure.
Check in at your hotel at Tezpur.

days.title: Day 8 : Departure Day
items: After your breakfast, you will be dropped at Guwahati Airport or Railway Station.
You'll go away with a variety of wonderful recollections.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which is beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7 (seven) business days in the customer's bank account.
